name: taskpilot
description: TaskPilot - quan ly cong viec ca nhan voi Kanban, React va Express

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix backend --include=dev && npm ci --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run smoke:local && npm run test:e2e
scripts.docker:up: npm run docker:setup && docker compose --env-file .env.docker up --build --wait --wait-timeout 180
